title: Media Outreach and Health Communication
description:
My work goes beyond traditional lectures; I have conducted video sessions on Vyas TV, reaching over a hundred higher education institutes simultaneously.

Since 2022, I have coordinated the Health Communication module for the Tata Memorial Centre, Mumbai, for the CPN Indonesia program for medical professionals and for the Master’s in Patient Navigation in Oncology, the Kevat program. The module involves lectures by me and invited guest faculty, aligning with the expertise of Prof. (Dr.) Sunetra Sen Narayan, Head of Health Communication at IIMC, and teaches students to communicate with patients and to counter health misinformation.

2026 · Conducting an online half-day workshop on fact-checking health misinformation, as students of the first Master’s batch present how they verified a health claim

title: Recognition and Global Engagements
description: I was awarded the Best Professor Teaching Advertising Management by ABP National B-School Awards in 2013, and my work extends globally. I have been an invited speaker at esteemed institutions like Jamia Milia Islamia, OP Jindal Global University, and Pennsylvania State University. My speaking engagements cover diverse topics, from advertising to new media.

title: Leadership in Education at IIMC (2008-09)
description: In the academic year 2008-09, I took on the role of Program Director for the Advertising & Public Relations Department at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC), New Delhi. Overseeing a diverse group of 60+ students, I conceptualized and managed the year-long Post-Graduate Diploma in Advertising & Public Relations. This encompassed syllabus creation, class organization, teaching, grading, and involvement in other PG Diploma programs and short-training courses, including the unique Development Journalism Program catering to media professionals from various countries.

title: Jury Member at NIFT Kangra
description:
They say one should not mix business with pleasure, but when you are invited to a place like Kangra, it’s not normal to not mix the two. Alka Rawat was kind enough to invite me to NIFT for the Fashion Communication jury, and that turned out to be a fun outing with my fellow jury members Anoop, Saransh, Astuti, Krattika and Anupam.

The student projects were interesting enough to keep us glued to our chairs the whole day. But the evenings were our own 🙂
